preconditions.description: The length of the array n must be between 3 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 1000000000 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element of the array a must be a positive integer between 1 and 10^9.
The length of the array a must match the specified length n.

postconditions.description: The output must start with either 'YES' or 'NO' indicating the possibility of making all elements equal.
If the output is 'YES', the number of lines must be m + 2, where m is the number of operations.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= n and 1 <= k <= n and i != j and i != k and j != k for i, j, k in operations)
postconditions.description: Each operation must consist of three distinct indices within the bounds of the array.
